$comment: Generic MCP client config for the modal-vault server (upstream modal-vault-server). Preferred install: scripts/vault-mcp-install.sh --client codex|claude|json|gh (harness-native surfaces). This file is the json-mode template for harness-side mounts (omp, pi-via-extension) and any streamable-HTTP client. Replace <workspace> with your Modal workspace and <MODAL_VAULT_API_TOKEN> with the bearer from the modal-vault-secret Secret. Never commit a real token.
